sources.метод: Same-specimen larval light-sheet calcium imaging and eFIB-SEM registration, followed by targeted two-photon validation and a separate rolling assay. Version 3 additionally models the larval connectome as a recurrent firing-rate network: synapse counts set connection strengths, predicted neurotransmitters set signs, and simulated Basin activation is compared with observed calcium-response valence. A null ensemble uses 1,000 out-degree-preserving shuffled networks.

sources.производительность: In one first-instar CNS, 119 of roughly 3,000 brain neurons responded to Basin activation; 25 responsive lineages and 101/119 traced neurons were reported. Separate third-instar cohorts showed reduced rolling (P=0.0037) and increased turning (P=0.025) after KC silencing during Basin activation (n=366/351; v3 Fig. 5C). Separately, v3 Figure 6 reports connectome-model AUC 0.74 (Mann-Whitney U p=0.045), response-sign accuracy 72.4%, and an out-degree-preserving-shuffle permutation p=0.025. These are author-reported within-study metrics, not reproduced or human validation.

sources.ограничения: One first-instar CNS underlies whole-brain imaging and EM registration; validation and rolling assays use other third-instar larvae. Version 3 Figure 6 does not report the exact evaluated-neuron denominator or a train/test split in the checked text; the reported 72.4% must not be assigned the nearby 20/26 tracing denominator. The graph-null result is a fly-neuron valence comparison, not Drosophila-to-ECAP transfer or clinical SCS evidence.

sources.авторы: Nagy Mekhail; Robert M Levy; Timothy R Deer; Leonardo Kapural; Sean Li; Kasra Amirdelfan; Corey W Hunter; Steven M Rosen; Shrif J Costandi; Steven M Falowski; Abram H Burgher; Jason E Pope; Christopher A Gilmore; Farooq A Qureshi; Peter S Staats; James Scowcroft; Tory McJunkin; Jonathan Carlson; Christopher K Kim; Michael I Yang; Thomas Stauss; Julie Pilitsis; Lawrence Poree; Dan Brounstein; Samuel Gilbert; Gerrit E Gmel; Robert Gorman; Ian Gould; Erin Hanson; Dean M Karantonis; Abeer Khurram; Angela Leitner; Dave Mugan; Milan Obradovic; Zhonghua Ouyang; John Parker; Peter Single; Nicole Soliday; Evoke Study Group
sources.модальность: ECAP-controlled closed-loop vs fixed-output open-loop SCS; device-measured neural response (ECAP) alongside VAS pain, PROMIS-29, EQ-5D-5L, ODI, POMS and opioid use
sources.задача: Prespecified 24-month durability analysis of clinical and quality-of-life outcomes in the Evoke randomised controlled trial
sources.метод: Secondary analysis of the double-blind, randomised, controlled, parallel-arm Evoke trial (NCT02924129) with 36 months of follow-up at 13 US sites; analysis performed October 2020 to April 2021. All randomised patients (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop) were included in the 24-month primary outcome analysis using last-observation-carried-forward; per-protocol completers at 24 months were 50 closed-loop and 42 open-loop.
sources.датасет: 134 randomised participants (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop); 24-month per-protocol completers 50 closed-loop and 42 open-loop
sources.производительность: At 24 months, >=50% overall pain reduction in 53/67 (79.1%) closed-loop vs 36/67 (53.7%) open-loop (difference 25.4%, 95% CI 10.0-40.8; P=.001) and >=80% reduction in 31/67 (46.3%) vs 20/67 (29.9%) (difference 16.4%, 95% CI 0.2-32.6; P=.047); no difference in safety profiles (study-related adverse event rate difference 6.0, 95% CI -7.8 to 19.7); quality-of-life, physical and emotional functioning and sleep gains paralleled opioid reduction or elimination
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: randomised controlled trial, not a predictive model
sources.ограничения: Secondary analysis of an already-randomised cohort, not a new trial, so it is not independent evidence relative to the 3- and 12-month Evoke reports. The 24-month primary analysis applies last-observation-carried-forward to all randomised patients, which assumes outcomes stay stable after dropout; only 50 and 42 patients per arm completed the 24-month visit. ECAP is a proxy for neural recruitment and dose, not a direct pain measurement.

sources.название: Trust-gated synthetic EEG augmentation reduces performance drops when generalizing to new patients
sources.авторы: Daniel Choi; Cordelia Yip; Andrew Choi; Junho Park
sources.модальность: Resting-state EEG in PainMunich chronic-pain case/control cohort; separate BCI IV-2a motor-imagery EEG stress-test dataset.
sources.задача: Control the risk that synthetic EEG augmentation worsens subject-disjoint case/control or motor-imagery classification on held-out real people.
sources.метод: For each subject-disjoint fold, a conditional latent-diffusion generator is fit on real training subjects only; a separate geometry-aware teacher fit on real training windows filters synthetic candidates by label consistency and confidence quantile. A fail-closed selector injects accepted windows only if held-out validation AUROC beats a real-only model by margin 0.01. Five-fold participant-disjoint CV with five seeds compares paired augmentation and real-only runs.
sources.датасет: PainMunich resting-state EEG dataset 1: 189 people (101 chronic-pain cases, 88 healthy controls); a separate BCI Competition IV-2a motor-imagery dataset has 9 people. Publisher Data availability links PainMunich BIDS-EEG on OSF and BCI IV-2a portal, with original-provider terms applying. Author code is linked from the publisher Code availability section.
sources.производительность: PainMunich at 5% training-subject scarcity: ungated augmentation caused test AUROC decline >0.01 in 56% of paired runs, versus 24% with trust-gated augmentation at q=0.99; mean AUROC was comparable. BCI IV-2a at 25% scarcity: AUROC 0.679 versus 0.627 and harm rate 0.16 versus 0.44. These are within-paper subject-disjoint results, not external clinical validation or patient outcomes.
sources.кросс_субъект: Participant-disjoint train/validation/test in five-fold CV repeated over five seeds; scarcity subsamples only training subjects. Generator and teacher fit only real training subjects/windows per fold. PainMunich test labels are chronic-pain case/control, not pain intensity.
sources.ограничения: This is a partial NS-06 analogue: labelled real training plus synthetic augmentation under participant shift, not synthetic-only source transfer or unlabeled-target alignment. The PainMunich label distinguishes chronic-pain cases from controls, not pain intensity, subjective relief, treatment response or SCS/ECAP outcome. The BCI benchmark is a different motor-imagery task, not a separate chronic-pain cohort. Author-defined harm is ΔAUROC degradation, a model-performance safety proxy rather than patient harm. Dataset access follows original provider terms; reported CV does not establish clinical deployment generalization.

sources.задача: Dissect whether acute heat nociception and tissue-injury-induced heat hypersensitivity in Drosophila larvae use the same neurons and molecular transducers.
sources.метод: Third-instar larval heat-probe rolling assays; brief UVC epidermal injury to induce hypersensitivity; TrpA1 isoform knockout/knockin and tissue-specific RNAi/perturbation; optogenetic and thermogenetic activation; GCaMP calcium imaging of larval CNS neurons; pharmacologic PLC manipulation.

sources.производительность: Acute heat nociception required TrpA1-D in peripheral C4da sensory neurons, whereas UVC injury-induced heat allodynia required TrpA1-C in larval brain BLA neurons; BLA synaptic transmission and Tachykinin receptor/Gq/PLC signaling were implicated in injury-induced heat responses. The paper reports behavioral and calcium-imaging experiments, not a predictive model benchmark.
sources.кросс_субъект: Not a human or cross-subject prediction study; experiments compare Drosophila larval genotypes and perturbations.
sources.ограничения: Drosophila larval mechanistic study of heat-evoked nocifensive rolling and injury-induced hypersensitivity. Rolling is a nociceptive/protective behavioral readout, not evidence of subjective pain. Does not assess human pain, clinical outcomes, ECAP, SCS, or transfer between species. Exact per-condition sample counts are referred to as bracketed values in figure legends but are not stated numerically in the checked machine-readable article text; sample_size therefore remains null.

sources.название: How much of fly walking is written in the wiring?
sources.авторы: Isabel Guan; Yuntian Zhao; Dingyuan Zhang; Shipeng Lyu; I-Ming Chen
sources.модальность: connectome, simulation_state
sources.задача: Test which fly leg-motor outputs depend on the specific ventral nerve cord wiring rather than generic graph statistics.
sources.метод: Fixed-synapse-weight rate models of two adult male VNC connectomes, six families of rewired network controls, prespecified antagonist-coordination criteria and fresh-noise confirmation runs.
sources.датасет: MaleCNS v1.0 and MANC v1.0 connectome leg-motor subnetworks (10,173 and 10,440 model neurons); source data attached to the preprint.
sources.производительность: Author-reported primary-window antagonist score S=0.312 for MaleCNS versus at most 0.144 for the rewired networks, and S=0.173 for MANC versus at most 0.084. Rhythmicity itself was often achieved by rewired networks; these are model outputs, not observed animal performance.
sources.кросс_субъект: Two independently reconstructed male adult fly connectomes were compared; no held-out animal/clinical evaluation.
sources.ограничения: The outputs concern a rate-model leg-motor circuit and antagonist coordination, not nociception, human ECAP or SCS. Glutamatergic transmission was assumed inhibitory; results are model-only, with no body or sensory feedback and no recording-based test of predicted phase relationships. MANC effects are weaker than MaleCNS. Preprint, not a peer-reviewed journal result.

validation.notes: The 64-cell-type visual network predicts measured single-neuron visual responses. Rechecked 2026-09-28: model predictions were compared with published neural recordings from 26 studies without fitting to those recordings; this is external within-species functional comparison, not human transfer. meta.scope: Pre-registered scientific boundaries for connectome-constrained Drosophila dynamics, abstract representation transfer, a separate physical ECAP observation model, and SCS programming or evaluation tasks.
invariants: A simulation label is not subjective human pain.
ECAP measures evoked neural recruitment and is not a direct measure of pain.
Drosophila is not treated as a direct model or digital twin of the human spinal cord.
Clinical SCS claims require patient-level human ECAP or telemetry linked to a pre-specified clinical outcome.
meta.author_review_scope: Delegated EVD-05 acceptance of bounded evidence conclusions on 2026-09-30; future substantive evidence changes and experiment proposals still require review. This does not approve the topic or establish GO.

entities.name: noxious_stimulus
entities.carrier: simulation environment or experimental stimulus apparatus
entities.measurement: commanded location, intensity, duration, and waveform
entities.permitted_conclusion: The applied exposure can be detected or its parameters can be estimated.

entities.name: nociceptive_response
entities.carrier: sensory and downstream neural or physiological system
entities.measurement: neural activity or physiological response after a noxious stimulus
entities.analysis_unit: trial within an animal or participant
entities.permitted_conclusion: A measurable response associated with potentially tissue-damaging stimulation occurred.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: The response is equivalent to subjective pain or chronic pain.

entities.name: protective_behavior
entities.measurement: movement, pose, withdrawal, guarding, or expert behavioral annotation
entities.permitted_conclusion: Observable protective behavior was detected under the defined protocol.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: Behavior alone quantifies subjective pain intensity.

entities.name: transferable_nociceptive_dynamics
entities.carrier: connectome-constrained Drosophila simulation and its explicitly defined latent state
entities.measurement: temporal neural population representation with stimulus, individual, and scenario provenance
entities.analysis_unit: trial nested in a held-out synthetic individual and scenario
entities.permitted_conclusion: The representation preserves reproducible dynamical invariants useful for a separately tested downstream task.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: The latent state is subjective pain, a human spinal-cord state, or an ECAP waveform.

entities.name: ecap_neural_recruitment
entities.carrier: electrically stimulated and recorded human neural tissue
entities.measurement: artifact-controlled evoked compound action-potential morphology, latency, area, and peak-to-peak amplitude
entities.time_scale: sub-millisecond to tens of milliseconds after a stimulation pulse
entities.analysis_unit: pulse nested in electrode configuration, session, and participant
entities.permitted_conclusion: The signal characterizes evoked neural recruitment and stimulation delivery under the recording configuration.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: ECAP is a direct measure of pain or proves clinical benefit.

entities.name: scs_response
entities.carrier: human patient receiving spinal cord stimulation
entities.measurement: pre-specified patient-level clinical outcome at a fixed follow-up time
entities.permitted_conclusion: The model predicts the defined clinical outcome in an independent patient-level evaluation.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: A waveform-only or within-patient window result establishes therapeutic efficacy or cross-subject prediction.

simulation_domain.neural_scope: Peripheral nociceptors and connectome-addressable ascending nociceptive neurons implicated in rapid escape and sustained avoidance; exact cell/root IDs must be frozen in the simulator manifest for the selected connectome release.
state_variables: neuron activation or spike state when the selected simulator supports it
synaptic input and output state when exposed by the simulator
body pose, joint state, contact state, and locomotor state
environment and stimulus state retained for audit but withheld from a detector when it is the target
stimuli: localized noxious thermal exposure when supported by the selected sensory model
observable_behaviors: locomotor trajectory and pose-derived protective response
simulation_domain.fallback_domain: A separate larval Class-IV multidendritic-nociceptor escape/rolling circuit may be used only as an explicitly different experiment; adult and larval circuits are not pooled.

experiments.name: simulation_stimulus_detection
experiments.input: simulated neural, pose, movement, or behavioral observations without the stimulus command
experiments.output: location, intensity, duration, or presence of a noxious stimulus
experiments.training_data: synthetic individuals and scenarios assigned only to training
experiments.independent_test: held-out synthetic individuals and held-out stimulus scenarios
experiments.success_criterion: pre-registered improvement over chance and leakage controls with confidence intervals
experiments.falsification_criterion: performance collapses after removing the stimulus command or under individual/scenario holdout

experiments.name: simulation_response_estimation
experiments.input: stimulus parameters and pre-stimulus simulation state
experiments.training_data: synthetic individuals and perturbations assigned only to training
experiments.independent_test: held-out individuals, parameter ranges, and perturbations
experiments.success_criterion: response features remain identifiable and calibrated under pre-registered perturbations
experiments.falsification_criterion: the response is not distinguishable from control or is determined by metadata leakage

experiments.name: physical_ecap_observation_validation
experiments.input: electrically recruited population activity passed through an explicit conduction, volume-conduction, electrode, artifact, and acquisition model
experiments.training_data: simulated recruitment conditions plus the training partition of authorized human ECAP recordings
experiments.independent_test: held-out participants, electrode configurations, and stimulation settings from human ECAP data
experiments.success_criterion: pre-registered waveform, latency, recruitment, and artifact characteristics satisfy bounds fixed from the human training reference
experiments.falsification_criterion: the physical observation model fails a required characteristic or matches only participants and configurations seen during fitting

experiments.name: scs_programming_and_evaluation
experiments.input: human ECAP or SCS telemetry, stimulation settings, and only for the clinical subtask pre-specified patient covariates
experiments.output: a pre-registered technical SCS target such as recruitment estimation, parameter selection, or closed-loop control; clinical response only when linked outcomes exist
experiments.training_data: authorized human SCS cohort split by participant; clinical labels are optional and task-specific
experiments.independent_test: held-out patients or a separate SCS cohort, with unseen settings where the task requires them
experiments.success_criterion: incremental value over a clinical or engineering baseline and the same model without Drosophila-derived pretraining, with calibrated uncertainty
experiments.falsification_criterion: no gain over controls, dependence on within-patient leakage, or absence of the outcome required by the declared task

transfer_chain.output: masked temporal embeddings with modality identity and no claim of species equivalence
transfer_chain.success_criterion: representation preserves pre-registered stimulus and response information under perturbation

transfer_chain.independent_test: held-out human participants and stimulation configurations
transfer_chain.success_criterion: transfer exceeds human-only, naive synthetic, randomized-connectome, and no-pretraining controls
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: no defensible common dynamical observable or no gain after participant-safe evaluation

transfer_chain.independent_test: held-out participants, configurations, and stimulation settings

transfer_chain.output: one pre-specified SCS target: recruitment estimation, artifact removal, parameter selection, closed-loop control, or conditional clinical response

transfer_chain.independent_test: held-out SCS patients or a separate cohort; clinical claims additionally require linked outcomes and follow-up
transfer_chain.success_criterion: incremental task-level value over engineering or clinical baselines and the same model without Drosophila-derived transfer
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: gain vanishes under participant holdout, requires target leakage, or the required target data are unavailable

ecap_like_observation_model.source_activity: population transmembrane action potentials elicited by electrical stimulation
ecap_like_observation_model.conduction_delays: path-length and fiber-parameter dependent delays applied before summation
ecap_like_observation_model.spatial_summation: signed summation over recruited fibers with distance and orientation weighting
ecap_like_observation_model.electrode_geometry: explicit stimulation and recording contact positions, spacing, polarity, and reference
ecap_like_observation_model.volume_conduction: forward observation operator from neural sources to recording contacts
disturbances: physiological noise including EMG and movement
measurable_characteristics: waveform morphology and classifiability against non-ECAP and artifact waveforms
N1 and later-component latency relative to stimulation
area under the curve and peak-to-peak amplitude
recruitment threshold and response versus amplitude, pulse width, polarity, and contact geometry

tolerance_protocol.reference: participant- and configuration-stratified distributions from held-out human ECAP data
tolerance_protocol.acceptance_rule: Before analysis, register metric-specific bounds from the human training reference only; every required characteristic must fall within its registered 95% reference interval or registered standardized-distance bound on held-out human data.
tolerance_protocol.reason_numeric_bounds_are_null: Raw comparator signals and a locked preprocessing protocol are required; inventing numeric bounds from abstracts would be unsupported.
tolerance_protocol.failure_rule: Failure of any required characteristic keeps the label ECAP-like only and blocks claims of human ECAP equivalence.

ecap_like_observation_model.prohibited_claim: A raw aggregate of simulator activity is an ECAP or a direct measure of pain.

stop_criteria.trigger: The simulator cannot be reproduced from fixed code, configuration, and seed, or target performance is explained by direct access to the stimulus command.
stop_criteria.measurement: independent rerun plus command-removal and leakage-control evaluation
stop_criteria.decision: stop claims for H1 and do not proceed with the affected representation
stop_criteria.reserve_result: release the simulator audit, failure analysis, and a bounded stimulus/response benchmark if reproducible components remain
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The simulator models pain or provides valid pretraining data.

stop_criteria.trigger: No Drosophila-derived dynamical observable can be mapped to a defensible human neural-recruitment descriptor without anatomical or semantic equivalence assumptions.
stop_criteria.measurement: completed representation-correspondence matrix with every candidate path marked absent, unjustified, or testable
stop_criteria.reserve_result: retain a Drosophila simulation, dataset-generation, and physical ECAP-modeling contribution as separate results
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: Drosophila dynamics transfer to human spinal-cord recruitment or pain assessment.

stop_criteria.trigger: Drosophila-derived pretraining does not improve the pre-selected participant-level ECAP or SCS metric over human-only, naive synthetic, and randomized-connectome controls, or worsens calibration.
stop_criteria.measurement: participant-level bootstrap confidence interval and calibration comparison on locked independent ECAP or SCS data
stop_criteria.decision: reject the representation-transfer hypothesis for the tested method and task
stop_criteria.reserve_result: report the negative transfer result and conditions under which synthetic pretraining fails
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: Connectome-constrained Drosophila pretraining improves human ECAP or SCS tasks.

stop_criteria.trigger: No legally and ethically available human dataset links SCS telemetry or ECAP to a pre-specified patient-level clinical outcome and follow-up time.
stop_criteria.measurement: documented dataset-access and field audit before the SCS experiment
stop_criteria.decision: do not run or claim clinical SCS-response prediction
stop_criteria.reserve_result: limit the dissertation result to Drosophila dynamics, ECAP-like physical observation modeling, and non-clinical human ECAP or SCS tasks supported by available data
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The method predicts clinical response to SCS.

stop_criteria.trigger: Performance exists only for windows from patients seen in training or disappears when patients are held out.
stop_criteria.measurement: patient-disjoint evaluation with participant-level confidence intervals
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The model predicts SCS response for new patients.
